flags.message: Only the applicant's 15-page filing was provisioned, not the respondent's position or the full Sixth Circuit order/dissent. The 0.82 vacatur forecast relies on the applicant's account of the Rule 60(b) claim and prior prejudice rulings, with an explicit uncertainty discount; these accounts were not independently verified.

The provisioned application reports a September 29, 2026 denial in separate Pike proceedings (26A414 and 26-5696). This was treated only as pre-arrival procedural history, not as this Warden application's outcome or resolution of the new Rule 60(b) issue. No target disposition or subsequent history was sought or encountered.
